new: Live sound: the output page's new switch, Stream sound to the room, sends one sound input of its computer through the relay to the room.
People elsewhere (a laptop at home, a headset in another place) hear it by default; devices in the room do not.
A per-device setting, Room's live sound: auto, on or off, in the Shared dialog and the headset menu's Settings.
A studio sound item can be set to Live sound: the stream then plays from where that item stands.
Rooms on a relay only: peer to peer and rooms on this device say it is not available.

A laptop joined from elsewhere and a Quest elsewhere hear it; a headset in the room does not, until its setting is On.
The Sound button turns it on and off on each device (a page starts with Sound off, so a remote laptop presses Sound first).
In a studio scene, a Live sound item: walk round it in a headset; the sound comes from it.
